closure_statement: V004 is closed as a valid descriptive and traceability experiment. It does not establish that intact action-conditioned future-space information changes transformation selection. Q1-Q5 remain unresolved, while Q6 is supported only at the reconstruction/traceability level.

next_design_priority.required_direction: Design a subsequent experiment capable of discriminating action-conditioned future-space information from baseline action preference/heuristic while preserving the decision-before-realised-future-access boundary.
next_design_priority.Q6_role: Retain the decision-to-T_acc reconstruction bridge as an established traceability component rather than treating it as evidence of causal or value effects.
